description:
Special Population Continuum of Care Network Information Session:
The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Administration for Children and Families, Office of Refugee Resettlement invites interested organizations to learn more about an upcoming opportunity supporting the Unaccompanied Alien Children Program through the Special Population Continuum of Care Network. A virtual information session is scheduled for Thursday, April 23, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. EST. Advance registration is appreciated, though same-day registration will be accepted. Please see the “Active Links” sections to join the event.

Interested parties are advised that the RFI response deadline has been extended, as reflected in this announcement.

All questions related to the virtual roundtable shall be submitted via email to Valarie Pels-Kohout at valerie.pelskohout@acf.hhs.gov no later than three (3) business days prior to the event.

1. (CURRENT) Registration Link:

https://acf-hhs-gov.zoomgov.com/meeting/register/bcQbyisgQ4OsHGqylaJibg
